+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from pytest import MonkeyPatch
+
+from slopgate._types import ObjectDict
+from slopgate.engine import evaluate_payload
+from tests.engine.support import finding_ids, write_config_from_defaults, write_slopgate
+
+
+def test_mixed_multiedit_keeps_unskipped_target_enforced(
+    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    repo = write_slopgate(tmp_path / "repo")
+    generated = repo / "generated"
+
+    def configure_skip_paths(defaults: ObjectDict) -> None:
+        defaults["skip_paths"] = [str(generated.resolve())]
+
+    write_config_from_defaults(tmp_path, monkeypatch, configure_skip_paths)
+    result = evaluate_payload(
+        {
+            "hook_event_name": "PreToolUse",
+            "tool_name": "MultiEdit",
+            "cwd": str(repo),
+            "tool_input": {
+                "edits": [
+                    {
+                        "file_path": "generated/output.py",
+                        "old_string": "",
+                        "new_string": "from typing import Any\nvalue: Any = 1\n",
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "file_path": "src/app.py",
+                        "old_string": "",
+                        "new_string": "from typing import Any\nvalue: Any = 1\n",
+                    },
+                ]
+            },
+        }
+    )
+
+    type_findings = [
+        finding for finding in result.findings if finding.rule_id == "PY-TYPE-001"
+    ]
+    assert type_findings, "the unskipped candidate must remain subject to strict rules"
+    assert {
+        str(finding.metadata.get("path")) for finding in type_findings
+    } == {"src/app.py"}
+    assert "generated/output.py" not in str(finding_ids(result))
*** End Patch
